title: Findings, economics, niche method, content engine, campaign plan, automation architecture

executive_summary.headline: A working, compliant affiliate platform scaffold with a live verification dashboard — and a hard stop on the three products, because the links supplied do not identify any product.

bullets.text: The three links cannot be turned into products. Each token is 9 characters where Amazon requires 10, and each direct catalog lookup returns Amazon's 'Page Not Found' page. Nothing about the products — name, price, rating, competition or commission — can be stated without inventing it, so every one of those cells is blank and flagged.

The other session's 'resolved' ASINs are an artifact, not a resolution. Both tokens produced a URL carrying lv=shuf and plpRedirect=mhFallback — Amazon's fallback shuffle — and two different tokens produced two different 'featured' items. A shuffle is not a mapping, so no product was attributed.

The compliance layer is the part of this brief that could be fully verified, and it is: 25 policy constraints read straight out of the Operating Agreement and the Program Policies, each with the quoted text, the source URL and the code guard that enforces it.

Correction made during the build: a public commission table does exist. Table 1 of the Standard Commission Income Statement is readable without a login and publishes fixed rates by category (for example 4.50% for Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive; 4.00% for All Other Categories). This site first recorded the opposite, then re-fetched and corrected it. What remains unverifiable is which category a given ASIN belongs to — air fryers are not named in the table — so the site publishes the table but multiplies it into no per-product earning figure.

'AI-powered' is scoped deliberately. Amazon forbids using Program Content or Special Links to train models without written approval, so the engine uses a model to draft and structure copy, never to invent product facts, and the build fails if a draft contains an unsourced number.
33 unit tests pass and the data audit returns zero errors. The audit is what enforces 'every row has a source' as a build gate rather than a promise.
Unblocking needs exactly three things from you: 10-character ASINs, your Associates ID, and PA-API credentials. The pipeline is written to accept all three without further code changes.

economics.formula: commission = (gross_charged − shipping − gift_wrapping − handling − taxes − service_charges − credits − rebates − card_processing − bad_debt) × rate_pct / 100

inputs.why: the ten deduction categories are stated in the policy text

inputs.owner: Standard Commission Income Statement Table 1 (rate) + your account (category mapping)
inputs.why: rates are published and verified (S14); what is missing is which category a given ASIN belongs to

economics.guard: model/economics.py raises RateNotAvailable rather than defaulting to a plausible-looking percentage. A revenue model built on an assumed rate is how affiliate dashboards end up reporting money that does not exist.
economics.risk_note: Amazon states it makes no representation about the traffic or commission income you can expect, and may cease all commission income on a breach — so the platform treats compliance as the primary control, not as a checklist afterthought.

niche_method.purpose: How a niche gets selected once data exists — disclosed weights, no hidden coefficients, and no score emitted on partial input.

weights.input_source: Amazon Best Sellers / New Releases rank movement
count of offers on the ASIN and Buy Box ownership
rating and review count from the product page
your rate card for the category

niche_method.refusal_rule: scoring.score() returns (None, missing[]) when any required factor is absent. Partial scores are never published, because a partial score is indistinguishable from a complete one in a sorted table.

invariants.rule: Every page carries Amazon's §5 sentence verbatim
Disclosure sits adjacent to the link, not behind a 'DISCLOSURE' click
No unsourced number, price, or percentage survives the build
Amazon copy may be truncated but not reworded
A missing fact renders as an explicit placeholder, never as prose
No earnings promise and no implied Amazon endorsement in any draft

stages.writes: candidate product records (all fields blank until sourced)

credential_contract: AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG — the tagged link suffix Amazon assigned to your account
AMAZON_PA_ACCESS_KEY / AMAZON_PA_SECRET_KEY — from Associates Central → Tools → Product Advertising API
AMAZON_PA_PARTNER_TYPE — the partner type Amazon issued with those credentials
non_goals: No scraping of Amazon pages to replace the API; Program Content may only be obtained through the approved channels.
No training on Program Content or Special Links.
No simulated earnings, clicks or conversions when an account is absent.
No auto-published content: drafts go through the claim checker and a human review step before they reach the site.

collector_proof.why: To show the intake path works end to end, the collector was pointed at Amazon's own Best Sellers page and read the values that page states about itself. These are unrelated to the operator's three products — they exist to prove name, ASIN, rating and price can be captured with a source attached to each value.

rows.name: Scott ComfortPlus Toilet Paper, 12 Triple Rolls, 231 Sheets per Roll, Septic-Safe, 1-Ply Toilet Tissue
Bounty Paper Towels Quick Size, White, 16 Family Rolls = 40 Regular Rolls

collector_proof.caveat: Do not copy this table into a monetized page. A published affiliate page may display a price only if Amazon serves the link containing that price, or the price came from Creators API / PA API. This is internal research, stamped with its date, and these prices have already moved.
